verdict.rationale: Kimi is an AI assistant that reasons over the user's own material inside the product. Its docs describe loading an entire codebase into a million-token context for whole-project understanding (kimi-docs-6), an agent that reads local project files (kimi-docs-1), and thinking modes aimed at large codebase analysis and long-document processing (kimi-docs-8), and a community user reports it working well as a planning assistant on their coding tasks (kimi-comm-12). The help center also lists deep research and agent modes, but only as bare titles. Missing for 10: documented insight or suggestion features for non-code data such as spreadsheets or uploaded datasets, detailed docs on deep research or agent analysis of user data, and stronger hands-on corroboration of the quality of the insights.
